title: Downtown Santa Monica Improvements
description:
Santa Monica has completed the next phase of its downtown glow up with new landscaping, off ramp cleanup and fresh sidewalk repairs. Recent work includes planting nearly 300 California native plants, clearing brush and debris at freeway off ramps and installing new curbs and sidewalks near Broadway and 6th Street.

These upgrades are part of the two year Realignment Plan, which invests $60 million in street improvements, safety enhancements and business support. A new downtown police substation at Santa Monica Place is also coming soon.

Learn more at santamonica.gov
transcript_text: Santa Monica has completed the next phase of the downtown Santa Monica glow-up, clearing brush and debris at the 20th Street offramp and adjacent protected bike lanes. Part of an ongoing improvement project at all Santa Monica freeway ramps, installing new curbs, driveways, sidewalks, and street repairs near Broadway and Sixth Street as part of the city's broader effort to repair 20,000 ft of sidewalks throughout the downtown area. planting fresh landscaping with approximately 300 California native plants at the fourth and fifth street off-ramp and preparing the 2,000 square ft site for the use of recycled water. Beautifying city gateways and shopping corridors to create a more welcoming and thriving downtown.
